verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hostable open-source platform, but the evidence never documents a setting to disable product telemetry or usage tracking. The closest items are adjacent: SDK attribute values stay local, the third-party tracking plugin is optional, and self-hosting is possible. None of these is an opt-out of the product's own telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
